text: But if it is asked how the division into prakriti (root) and pratyaya (affix) is to be understood, this point does not cause any wonder in the case of the yellow, the blue, and the water, because it is well known that the science of grammar (vyakarana) is concerned with expounding the division into roots and affixes. Thus, the first sentence of the great commentator Patanjali, the Bhagavat, is: “Now, the instruction regarding words” (Mahabhashya 1.1.1). The meaning of this is: The word “atha” (now) is used to indicate the subject matter (adhikara).
